title: Ihi

paragraphs: He had two sons, Avuha and Meniman, both distinguished and pious, as in [Megillah 28a](https://www.sefaria.org/Megillah.28a.20). They lived in Shmuel’s time, as explained in their entries. [Eruvin 74a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.74a.8) reads Ayvut bar Ihi. Hyman proposes Avuha there.[^1]

notes.text: The Eruvin episode continues at [Eruvin 74b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.74b.1), where Rav Anan removes the side post Shmuel had permitted. Heilprin treats the Ayvut passage under [Avuha bar Ihi](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=120&lang=en) and cross-references it from [Ayvut bar Ihi](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=395&lang=en).
